confidence_notes: Recent Jaipur price aggregates give a useful baseline for meals, coffee and beer, but only approximate the July 2026 window. Accommodation is a broad low-season model estimate; cocktail and wine prices are less certain and estimated from their local price relationship to beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city used; food and drink estimates use Jaipur price aggregates, while accommodation reflects Jaipur's lower-cost heritage-tourism market.
